review_kind: fresh initially blind independent WHOLE audit of the NEW all-D global induction
candidate_status: candidate proof - unverified pending both whole audits and coordinator reconciliation

per_inference_checks.claim: Marked official count and scalar-only conclusion
per_inference_checks.challenge: Wrong quotient, insertion histories, an extra n! factor, or a claim that equality evaluates the common value.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Official B4 and the official notes fix the full polygon count with orientations distinguished. DC applies to exactly that marked count. The final conclusion is existence/equality only, with no numerical value.

per_inference_checks.claim: Exact extendable GE class including zero ambient colors
per_inference_checks.challenge: A small diameter, one extendable subclass, or an H_(D-1) limit could be substituted for one small full exterior valid for EVERY filling.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The class requires a positive-area Jordan disk, complete canonical colored/ranked boundary, bounded perimeter and a single small full exterior for all fillings. Zero colors are allowed; positive area requires two active directions. The inductive quantifier covers every fixed exterior constant.

per_inference_checks.claim: Exact dilation and finite nonnegative limiting lower count
per_inference_checks.challenge: Unspecified port subdivisions, a zero dilation count, or assumed supermultiplicativity.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Every boundary edge has M consecutive ranked subdivisions. The full reference M-grid provides one filling and one exterior for every M. Finite alphabet bounds give finite normalized counts and Lambda>=0 without supermultiplicativity.

per_inference_checks.claim: Accepted scopes and reviewer independence
per_inference_checks.challenge: Using G4, UR3, CKP or a root outline as a proof, or counting old local authorship as a new independent local audit.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Ten separately accepted interfaces are premises. The new induction, belt, conditioning and assembly are reconstructed here. Prior S_D authorship and G4 R1 role are disclosed; this review does not re-audit its author's old local theorem independently.

per_inference_checks.claim: Finite origin alphabet and actual boundary tubes
per_inference_checks.challenge: A perimeter-only estimate with arbitrarily many tiny holes, or coordinates charged separately for every tile.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: A known origin set has a fixed finite presence/type alphabet. Arclength sampling of each ACTUAL curve gives O(rP+r^2) origins; finite boundary lists sum these terms and component costs. No arbitrary-hole perimeter-only consequence is used.

per_inference_checks.claim: Area cost for a known small Jordan block
per_inference_checks.challenge: Boundary or absolute-position information could dominate a tiny block's area.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: A reference block of t tiles has area>=t, perimeter<=4d_D t, and t>=1. The known-boundary alphabet cost O(area+perimeter+1) is O_D(area); no per-alternative-tile absolute coordinate charge remains.

per_inference_checks.claim: Physical visible-chain extrusion
per_inference_checks.challenge: Overlap, reversed chain orientation, an endpoint cap, or an absent-color failure.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: At transverse coordinate det(v_i,x), old parallel sections are intervals and addition of [0,v_i] moves their right endpoints by v_i. The stated +v_j then -v_j visible chain increases the transverse coordinate; its unit extrusions exhaust disjoint belt strips. Parallel extremes add endpoint edges only. Zero steps are skipped.

per_inference_checks.claim: One balanced reference exterior with old ranks fixed
per_inference_checks.challenge: Reversed other-color steps could change ranks, or padding could depend on a source filling.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The old chain has a_i=N_i; new belt edges give rank N_i+1. Reversed j steps retain their original j rank in reverse orientation. All old positions, origin and heights stay fixed. Padding depends only on boundary; after padding, ONE chosen full reference is dilated.

per_inference_checks.claim: Exact UR2 grid base
per_inference_checks.challenge: A disk could have nonunique internal phases despite a unique balanced count, or a dimer limit could be tacitly imported.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Invertible two-column V fixes the full coordinate grid. Each GE filling glues to the fixed full grid exterior and hence is its unique restriction. The M-grid gives the same argument for every M, so both counts are one and Delta2=0.

per_inference_checks.claim: Positive-deficit normalization on one balanced domain
per_inference_checks.challenge: p=max N could be much smaller than r, destroying the deficit or perimeter normalization.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Delta>=a r^2, Delta<=log Z<=K_D p^2 and p<=Cr imply comparability, p->infinity, bounded normalized perimeter and Delta/p^2>=a/C^2. The belt gives one full balanced extension to Z_D.

per_inference_checks.claim: Uniform compactness of actual Jordan boundaries
per_inference_checks.challenge: The limiting loop might self-touch or retrace and fail to be Jordan.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Constant-speed parametrizations have bounded Lipschitz constants and a uniform subsequential limit. Its image is rectifiable and area zero. The argument explicitly allows retracing and disconnected winding-one regions.

per_inference_checks.claim: Winding, compact core inclusion and area convergence
per_inference_checks.challenge: Hausdorff boundary convergence alone need not determine interiors.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Away from the compact limiting curve, a straight uniform boundary homotopy avoids the test point and fixes winding. It is eventually zero or one, uniformly on compacts. Indicator convergence off the zero-area curve gives area convergence by bounded convergence.

per_inference_checks.claim: Zero limiting area cannot carry positive deficit
per_inference_checks.challenge: A thin highly ramified disk could retain quadratic boundary information.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Every actual normalized boundary has length O(1). In physical scale its one-curve fixed-width tube costs O(p), while the disk area is o(p^2). The alphabet estimate forces log Z=o(p^2), contradicting the deficit.

per_inference_checks.claim: One subquadratic quantitative cover on the full convex zonogon
per_inference_checks.challenge: Intrinsic paths in ragged disks or a nonquantitative compactness cover could cost quadratic entropy.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The balanced extension supplies a fixed convex domain, bounded normalized ranges and a uniform extrinsic Lipschitz bound. Spatial/value quantization gives logarithmic cover size O(delta^-2 log(2/delta)); delta=1/log(p+2) makes this o(p^2).

per_inference_checks.claim: The entire selected fiber has one necessary limiting tangent profile
per_inference_checks.challenge: Averaging slopes across a nonconvex K_D, or controlling only one representative.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Every fiber member is O(delta_j) from its representative; representatives have a uniform limit h. Thus the entire fiber converges to h. Vh=x and bounded-derivative distributional minor closure give Dh in necessary compact K_D almost everywhere. No convexity or sufficiency is assumed.

per_inference_checks.claim: Quantitative strict error caps precede rational denominators
per_inference_checks.challenge: An existential q-dependent tolerance could fail after choosing a rational net.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The full accepted S_D body has q-free square-root loss and buffer/cut constants. Epsilon is freely chosen small for prescribed loss and collar first; only then are the finite net, periods and maximum physical scale thresholds selected.

per_inference_checks.claim: Strict extraction uses any later common reference
per_inference_checks.challenge: Independent best local references or replacement interiors near the tangent might be required.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The whole outer source estimate supplies the intermediate window's entire needed buffer. At large scale inner tiles are recoverable and the reference core lies inside outer. S_D applies to ANY actual reference with this common estimate, hence to the later joint T_j; its inserted interiors are arbitrary.

per_inference_checks.claim: One adjacent merged pair covers every boundary tangent
per_inference_checks.challenge: Zero rows, more than one zero minor, antiparallel rows, or D3 could force several nonsingleton groups.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: OC gives a finite cut and uniformly bounded A and inverse. Pair any zero row with one adjacent slot, or take consecutive positive-parallel rows otherwise. Exactly one color pair is merged; all other D-2 groups remain color singletons even if tangent-degenerate. Rank two excludes a D3 choice of two zero rows.

per_inference_checks.claim: Uniform source shapes and common affine chart offsets
per_inference_checks.challenge: A zero minor could make A singular, or each filling could require a different target translation.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Weighted Cauchy-Binet gives a uniform positive determinant bound for valid cuts. Source shapes are inverse images of target squares with fixed area/eccentricity bounds. CW formulas use the same cut, tangent and offset for all source fillings in a window.

per_inference_checks.claim: Winding includes whole fixed buffers and all relevant source tiles
per_inference_checks.challenge: Corner closeness or point inclusion may miss an entire tile or its incident star.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Source error is chosen below the theta collar and physical scale absorbs fixed tile/star diameters. CW's boundary homotopy includes the whole target core and enlargement in every image. The margin explicitly contains images of every whole source tile meeting the inner region.

per_inference_checks.claim: All rare selected-pair tiles are counted
per_inference_checks.challenge: Rare tiles could lie anywhere or touch the target boundary.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The chosen target pair minor is exactly zero, and full boundary affine control holds on the enlarged square. Accepted FL1 yields S=O_D(epsilon L^2+L+1) for whole and touching tiles, without a location-band hypothesis.

per_inference_checks.claim: A genuinely local anchored mesh code
per_inference_checks.challenge: Using global contents p instead of L, outside exit matching, or log p per disk/tile.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: LW's local rank ranges and crossing words give O_D(L^2/r0+epsilon r0^2 L^2+r0^2 L+r0L+r0^2+log(R+2)). One connected trace anchor per window supplies absolute data. Arbitrarily large p/L changes only that one logarithmic charge.

per_inference_checks.claim: Actual retained faces and closed cleanliness
per_inference_checks.challenge: Clipping a global face could create fake ports; an outside forbidden tile touching a block vertex could spoil SP.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: LW retains actual global selected faces with whole closure inside its buffered window. Closed-face and incident-tile cleanliness includes all touching vertices and full stars. The lifted code fixes complete good boundaries and supplies the deterministic CW anchor after reconstruction.

per_inference_checks.claim: Exact one-pair/D-2-singleton port bijection
per_inference_checks.challenge: A merged track could return or a coarse curve could hide multiple fine chains.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The clean interior RM1 face satisfies the accepted SP hypothesis. Singleton barriers prevent return for any fixed number D-2 of singleton colors. Each active coarse curve has two prescribed fine ports and one determined fine identity; no unrestricted erased-event reinsertion is used.

per_inference_checks.claim: An actual small full lower-direction exterior for every filling
per_inference_checks.challenge: A diameter estimate or separate exterior per filling would not meet UR_(D-1).
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: There are at most D(r0-1) active curves. Deleting inactive full curves has a constant contribution on the connected disk and causes only a fixed translation/rank shift. The resulting ONE standard full exterior, with O_D(r0) contents and perimeter, works for every coarse filling. Zero ambient colors are permitted.

per_inference_checks.claim: SP transfers the exact inductive deficit at all integer dilations
per_inference_checks.challenge: Scale-one equality or an H_(D-1) balanced subsequence may fail to control these actual disks.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: SP's full count bijection is valid at one and every integer M with consecutive port ranks, translation and rank normalization scaled consistently. Therefore the exact GE_(D-1,C_D)(r0) induction applies and bounds each deficit by eta_-(r0)r0^2.

per_inference_checks.claim: Many tiny Jordan blocks do not multiply the inductive error
per_inference_checks.challenge: The number of blocks in one selected face could be uncontrolled.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: RM1 gives total perimeter O_D(r0) and total area O_D(r0^2). Isoperimetry bounds the total fine area below beta r0^2 by O_D(sqrt(beta)r0^2); alphabet pays these counts. Only O_D(1/beta) larger blocks use the inductive deficit. Fixed-D metrics are comparable.

per_inference_checks.claim: All mesh, block and anchor costs vanish in the required order
per_inference_checks.challenge: An r0-dependent linear term, unrestricted block count or log R could remain leading.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: O_D((L/r0+1)^2) retained faces multiply the aggregated per-face loss, not a per-block bound. Choose beta, then r0 for eta_-/beta and 1/r0, then epsilon for epsilon r0^2, then L for all linear/constant/anchor terms. The budget is per source physical area.

per_inference_checks.claim: All tolerances are fixed before the Vitali radii
per_inference_checks.challenge: Later periods, shapes or window counts could force earlier parameters to shrink.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The fixed outside area coefficient comes first; delta,theta,zeta precede rho. Shape constants precede beta,r0,error caps. Strict periods follow tolerances; radii and a finite list follow these; j becomes large next; M is last at fixed j. Finite cut/pair choices are maximized at fixed D.

per_inference_checks.claim: Strict and boundary strata exhaust the useful almost-everywhere set
per_inference_checks.challenge: A positive mass of nearly degenerate strict slopes, an absent strict stratum or an all-minor-zero tangent.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Within the strict stratum, sets 0<minimum minor<rho decrease to empty and have arbitrarily small area. Exact boundary tangents use SP; an empty strict set is simply omitted. Rank two excludes all minors zero.

per_inference_checks.claim: Differentiability yields the required whole-window family
per_inference_checks.challenge: Only pointwise or unbuffered control, or unbounded eccentricity.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: For the ONE limiting profile, differentiability supplies arbitrarily small complete-window errors with c=h(x)-Jx in ker V. Fixed strict truncation and finite boundary cuts bound shape eccentricity. Window closures lie compactly inside Omega; no modulus uniform over arbitrary profiles is assumed.

per_inference_checks.claim: Disjoint finite windows cover almost all useful area
per_inference_checks.challenge: Greedy windows of different shapes could leave positive area or intersect at their closures.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: A remaining candidate must meet a selected window of at least half its diameter, else finite total area is contradicted. A missed good point lies in a bounded enlargement of the selected tail. Uniform regularity bounds its outer measure by the tail area, tending to zero. A finite partial list loses another delta; inner shrinking loses at most 2theta A_D.

per_inference_checks.claim: Every source in the same fiber meets every chosen local hypothesis
per_inference_checks.challenge: Choosing one reference first could hide bad family members or different offsets.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The window list is fixed. Its spans p_j ell_alpha tend to infinity, all scale thresholds are finite, and uniform convergence of the ENTIRE fiber gives the same physical offset p_j c_alpha and whole buffered estimates for every source simultaneously.

per_inference_checks.claim: The outside code has a fixed leading area coefficient
per_inference_checks.challenge: A rho-dependent number of windows or many holes could create a leading unbudgeted boundary charge.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Record all original tiles meeting the complement of inner windows. Its normalized area is at most 2delta+2theta A_D+o(1). Its actual boundary list is one B_j curve plus finitely many fixed window sides, giving O(p_j) summed tube cost and finite component terms. Only lower-order constants depend on the list.

per_inference_checks.claim: One actual full reference serves every local comparison
per_inference_checks.challenge: Independently maximal local code classes need not share a reference.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The profile fiber is chosen first, then all original outside data and ALL boundary codes/absolute anchors are conditioned jointly. Their number is product-bounded. Only after choosing one largest joint class is ONE actual T_j selected.

per_inference_checks.claim: Strict local families compare to that same later reference
per_inference_checks.challenge: S_D might require an independently optimal reference.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: For each strict window, distinct intermediate restrictions have actual full representatives in the common class. The accepted quantitative S_D interface permits the joint T_j and yields the corresponding exact core lower dilation count plus the chosen physical-area loss.

per_inference_checks.claim: No original source tile is discarded by charting
per_inference_checks.challenge: A target window record might not recover source tiles straddling the inner window.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The code plus good-disk fillings reconstructs the full target record and absolute lift. CW applies its whole-tile inverse/filter to all source tiles meeting inner. Strict larger restrictions and the original outside record supply the rest. Incompatible combinations only enlarge the upper product.

per_inference_checks.claim: Fine target, coarse count disk and original fine pullback stay distinct
per_inference_checks.challenge: An equality of SP counts could be mistaken for an equality of geometric regions.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: SP identifies B_tar and Qbar counts at every M. C_src is the separate reference inverse fine disk. The lower construction inserts choices through the full chart inverse into C_src and never asserts these three shapes equal.

per_inference_checks.claim: Arbitrary target fillings pull back to the SAME fine region
per_inference_checks.challenge: The inverse chart changes inside and might change the original region.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: First glue to the fixed full target exterior. Its old normalization fixes exterior heights and hence the complete old inverse fine boundary. The inverse full tiling's bounded Jordan region with that boundary is exactly C_src. The interior map may change. Forward charting recovers the target filling.

per_inference_checks.claim: Different charts provide independently gluable fine patches
per_inference_checks.challenge: Global chart maps need not commute, or shared vertices could carry incompatible ranks.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: All patches use ONE T_j. Within each chart the reference inverse preserves disjoint interiors and shared incidences. Across windows cores lie strictly inside disjoint closed outer source windows. Complete boundary heights/ranks agree with the one exterior; only the resulting fine patches are glued, without commuting global charts.

per_inference_checks.claim: Exact integer dilation and tuple recovery
per_inference_checks.challenge: Approximate chart scaling or a favorable M subsequence would not suffice.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: Reference grid heights satisfy a_MT(Mx)=M a_T(x); chart content/translation become Mp and Mb0. CW pulls M B_tar back to exact M C_src with every boundary rank fixed. SP works at every M, strict counts use exact M cores, and restriction plus local forward charts recovers the tuple inside exact MB_j.

per_inference_checks.claim: Lower insertions may leave all upper conditioned classes
per_inference_checks.challenge: Arbitrary interiors could cease to be affine or change collar codes.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The lower target is unrestricted Z_D(MB_j). Only complete boundaries and the fixed full exterior remain fixed. Profile, upper codes and collared interior records need not persist, so arbitrary replacement interiors are legal.

per_inference_checks.claim: Correct finite-product liminf order
per_inference_checks.challenge: There are increasingly many blocks as j grows, and M thresholds might not be uniform in j.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: At each fixed j the list is finite and the product holds for every M. Nonnegative finite log counts give liminf of its finite sum at least the sum of liminfs. No infinite product, reverse inequality or j-uniform M threshold is used.

per_inference_checks.claim: Physical area budgets close the full induction
per_inference_checks.challenge: Small-block errors, many windows, collars, codes or anchors could multiply the prescribed loss.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: All leading local costs are per outer physical area, and disjoint windows have summed area<=A_D p_j^2. The fixed finite list contributes only lower-order perimeter/linear/log terms. The resulting deficit bound c_D(2delta+2theta A_D)+zeta A_D+o(1) contradicts a/C^2 by the prior parameter choice. This proves the actual UR_(D-1)->UR_D step.

per_inference_checks.claim: Full balanced limits at ALL integer sizes
per_inference_checks.challenge: An H result on favorable multiples or one gridded reference provides insufficient entropy.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: The full balanced disk is in GE with empty exterior. For each fixed r, UR bounds the all-large-M liminf at Mr. RP injects into every p between Mr and (M+1)r with Mr/p->1. Only then take r along a bounded limsup sequence; eta(r)->0 gives equality of all-integer liminf and limsup.

per_inference_checks.claim: Fixed-D then growing-D official scalar equality
per_inference_checks.challenge: A D,n interchange, only balanced coarse counts, or a uniform-in-D error assumption.
per_inference_checks.reconstruction: For fixed D, floor/ceiling group counts are sandwiched by full balanced B_D(p) and B_D(p+1); both normalize to ell_D. Exact accepted DC gives ell_D<=Lminus<=Lplus<=ell_D+h2(1/D)+1/D. One fixed D bounds finiteness; only then D->infinity forces equality and ell_D convergence. No numerical value or uniform UR_D rate is claimed.

scope_limits: The common numerical value and full annual B4 answer remain unclaimed.
No novelty, priority, new current best bound, PR, or arbitrary-profile sufficiency is asserted.
UR_D applies to the exact fixed-D extendable complete-boundary GE class; no uniform-in-D rate is proved.
Accepted local premises retain their separate acceptance scopes; this auditor's old S_D authorship is not counted as a new independent local audit.
Only the coordinator may promote after reading both complete whole audits and reconciling all substantive objections.
